approve the application for a home occupation for “Luna Cosmetic Artistry” located at 1860 East Frontier Road subject to the following: Findings: 1. A Home Occupation with customers is a conditionally allowed for this location. 2. No other Home Occupations are on file as being in operation with ¼ mile of this location. City of Holladay Planning Commission Meeting - 01/21/2020 3 3. This request is deemed as a low-impact operation with all procedures occurring within the home. 4. The property owner shall provide off street parking. 5. It is not anticipated that traffic will be a problem due to the small-scale nature of the use. 6. There are no outside employees proposed or allowed with the use which will reduce the need for parking. 7. The use provides a desirable service to the community. Conditions: 1. Off-street parking areas shall be maintained as available during business hours. No on-street parking for clients, they must be in the homeowner’s driveway or other parking allowed. 2. Operational permit and licensure are subject to review and revocation upon finding of non-compliance. 3. The business is limited to no more than one client at a time on the premises. 4. Hours of operation are limited to Monday through Friday from 10:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m
